name: Queensland Coastal Pass for international students
summary: One-month, one-direction rail pass between Brisbane and Cairns for overseas visitors, including student visa holders.
key: $209.00 for Brisbane and Cairns (or vice versa), 1 month.
who: Genuine overseas visitors to Australia, including international visitors on working holiday and student visas.
catches: Travel in one direction only, with no backtracking.
A minimum of one 24-hour break of journey is compulsory.
Purchasers have twelve months from the date of purchase to commence travel.

evidence.quote: including international visitors on working holiday and student visas.
Travel can be taken over a one-month period.
